dex.text: Lives on the very edge of the riverbank, where the grass is still making up its mind about being water. Always looks as if it has just remembered an appointment.
dex.fact: Water voles are Britain's fastest-declining mammal, and they inspired Ratty in The Wind in the Willows.

dex.text: Knows exactly how to spend a sunny afternoon, which is mostly messing about by the water. Will talk for hours, provided you let it pick the subject.
dex.fact: Water voles are not rats at all, despite the nickname, and are closer cousins of hamsters and lemmings.
